algorithm: In-memory CRUD over HTTP with JSON bodies

classes.desc: In-memory record collection backing the API.
classes.name: Store

classes.desc: BaseHTTPRequestHandler routing GET/POST to the Store.
classes.name: ApiHandler

complexity: O(n) per list/stats request, O(1) per create
data_flow_ascii:
urllib client -> HTTP request -> ApiHandler
ApiHandler -> Store (in-memory list) -> JSON response
Store: list_records / add_record / stats
description_sentence: Serves a small JSON REST API for the topic records, with health, list, create, and stats endpoints.
failure_note: Malformed JSON bodies are treated as empty objects; unknown routes return 404 JSON. The server shuts down cleanly via server.shutdown() after the self-test.

functions.desc: Return a copy of all stored records.
functions.name: Store.list_records

functions.desc: Append a record built from the posted JSON payload.
functions.name: Store.add_record

functions.desc: Aggregate record count, mean value, and active count.
functions.name: Store.stats

functions.desc: Bind a ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 and serve it in a thread.
functions.name: start_server

functions.desc: Exercise every endpoint with urllib and print a results table.
functions.name: run_self_test

functions.desc: Parse args; self-test by default or serve with --serve.
functions.name: main

label: REST API service
output_shape: A results table with one line per exercised endpoint (method, path, status code, summary) plus a SELF-TEST PASSED/FAILED line.
pitch_sentence: A self-contained {topic} REST API in pure Python that starts on localhost, proves every endpoint works with a live self-test, and shuts itself down.

qa.a: The demo and --serve mode are for local development; binding loopback only avoids accidentally exposing the unauthenticated in-memory store on a network.
Nowhere; the Store lives in process memory and resets on every run, which keeps the demo deterministic.
run_self_test issues real HTTP requests against the threaded server with urllib and prints a PASSED/FAILED verdict.
qa.q: How is the default run verified?

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} REST API in Python (stdlib http.server) with JSON endpoints, an in-memory store, and a threaded self-test that exercises every route via urllib; demo binds 127.0.0.1, verifies all endpoints, and exits cleanly.
run_notes: Add --serve to keep the server running instead of self-testing.
scaling_note: ThreadingHTTPServer handles modest concurrency, but the shared list is not lock-protected and everything is single-process, so this suits local demos, not production traffic.
storage_note: In-memory only: records live in a Python list inside the Store and vanish when the process exits. No database or files are used.
tradeoff_note: Stdlib-only keeps the template dependency-free, at the cost of hand-rolled routing and no request validation framework.
